title: 3BD Nashville Retreat - Sleeps 8, Near Downtown
description:
✔️ Quiet neighborhood — 10 minutes to downtown Nashville
✔️ 3 bedrooms, 2 baths — sleeps up to 8 with sleeper sofa
✔️ Full kitchen plus two cozy dining nooks
✔️ Large smart TV and fast Wi‑Fi
✔️ In‑home washer and dryer
✔️ Easy access to L&L Market, Sylvan Supply, and 51st Ave

The space
• Nations Basecamp blends cozy comfort with quick city access
• Wake to coffee in the breakfast nook, then explore The Nations’ cafes
• After outings, stream a game in the plush living room
• Cook simple favorites and gather for dinner and card games
• Ideal for families, couples, or friends who want a calm city stay

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Bright living room with large smart TV for movie nights
• Quaint dining table for 4 plus a separate breakfast nook for 4
• Central heat/AC for year‑round comfort
• Fast Wi‑Fi and a laptop‑friendly spot for quick check‑ins

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 8)
• This home includes 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.
• Bedroom 1 (Primary): King bed, ensuite bathroom; sleeps 2
• Bedroom 2: Queen bed; sleeps 2
• Bedroom 3: Two twin beds; sleeps 2
• Living Room — Queen sleeper sofa; sleeps 2
Bathrooms:
• Ensuite Bathroom: Single vanity, standing shower
• Guest Bathroom: Single vanity, shower/tub combo

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with standard appliances, coffeemaker, and toaster
• Breakfast nook seating 4; dining table seating 4
• Cookware, bakeware, utensils, are provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• In‑unit/home washer and dryer for longer stays
• We provide bedding, towels and a small starter set of essentials
• Smart TV and Wi‑Fi

📍 Location Highlights
• L&L Market and Sylvan Supply — shops, eats, and coffee nearby
• 51st Ave/Charlotte Ave in The Nations — local dining and breweries
• Broadway/Downtown — honky‑tonks and live music ~10 minutes
• Centennial Park & The Parthenon — green space and landmarks
• Nissan Stadium, Midtown, and Germantown — quick drives

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking: Two off‑street/lot spaces with passes provided; upon request, a third pass may be available (not guaranteed). Free street parking on 33rd Ave N
• Stairs: The home has stairs
• Pets: This home is not pet friendly. If there is found evidence of an animal's presence during your stay or post check‑out, guests will be charged an additional cleaning fee
• Check‑in time is 4:00 PM and checkout time is 10:00 AM
